newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korea's KFMIA sees its '97 wheat import flat.
newsitem.headline: South Korea's KFMIA sees its '97 wheat import flat.

text.p: Korea Flour Mills Industrial Association (KFMIA) said on Wednesday wheat imports are expected to remain little changed in 1997 from 2,276,605 tonnes a year ago.
"We expect our wheat import this year to be in the range between 2.2 million tonnes and 2.3 million tonnes," a KFMIA official told Reuters.
He said 1996 wheat imports rose 7.3 percent from 2,121,430 tonnes the previous year.
Imports from the United States, which made up 68 percent of the total, rose to 1,553,010 tonnes in 1996 from 1,452,024 tonnes.
Australia supplied 650,792 tonnes, up from 612,705 tonnes from 1995, while Canada supplied 72,803 tonnes, compared with 56,701 tonnes a year earlier.
